registrationStatus: Working-tree scope recorded before implementation; not a committed financial preregistration.

addresses: The adapter-composition part of obligation 10's next action. causal-ope-v8, ope-rational-v2, ope-rational-v3, both successor learners and every frozen path stay unchanged; CE-RL-010/011/012/014/018/019 are not retired.
data: Deterministic synthetic completed bars, exact funding events and synthetic dyadic target models only.
